axi_fifo_wr.summary: AXI write-channel FIFO: W beats are packed into a 32-entry RAM via wr/rd pointers and drained through a read stage and output register, while AW and B channels pass through.

blocks.name: Write FIFO
blocks.description: Dual-pointer RAM FIFO buffering W beats with registered read stage

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO RAM storing packed W beats (data, strobe, last)

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: FIFO write pointer advanced on each accepted W beat; drives full/empty

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: FIFO read pointer advanced on each RAM read; drives full/empty

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: FIFO full flag blocking writes and deasserting wready

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag blocking reads and invalidating read stage

anchors.name: write
anchors.why: FIFO RAM write enable on accepted W beat

anchors.name: read
anchors.why: FIFO RAM read enable loading mem_read_data_reg

anchors.name: mem_read_data_reg
anchors.why: RAM read-data register between FIFO memory and output register

anchors.name: mem_read_data_valid_reg
anchors.why: Valid flag of RAM read stage; gates reads and output valid

anchors.name: s_axi_w
anchors.why: Packed W word (data, strobe, last) written into FIFO

anchors.name: hold
anchors.why: Write-hold flag, tied 0 when FIFO_DELAY disabled; gates wready

blocks.name: W output register
blocks.description: Output register presenting W beats to the master with valid/ready

anchors.name: m_axi_w_reg
anchors.why: Output register holding W beat presented to master

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Master W valid from output register valid

anchors.name: store_output
anchors.why: Load enable for output register when master ready or idle

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Master write data unpacked from output register

blocks.name: Slave W input
blocks.description: Slave W handshake and payload feeding FIFO writes

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave W valid; triggers FIFO write when not full

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: Slave W ready, asserted when FIFO not full and not held

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Slave write data packed into FIFO word

anchors.name: m_axi_wready
anchors.why: Master W ready; allows output register to load next beat

blocks.name: AW and B bypass
blocks.description: Write address and response channels wired straight through

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave AW valid bypassed to master AW channel

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address bypassed to master interface

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Master AW valid driven directly by slave awvalid

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid bypassed from master B channel

axi_fifo_rd.summary: AXI read-channel FIFO: AR channel passes through (FIFO_DELAY=0), while R-channel beats are packed into a pointer-based circular memory FIFO and output through a registered read stage.

blocks.name: R FIFO memory
blocks.description: Circular buffer with full/empty from extended write/read pointers.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO memory holding packed R beats: data, last, id, resp.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: FIFO write pointer advanced on each accepted master R beat.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: FIFO read pointer advanced when output stage consumes an entry.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: FIFO full flag blocking writes and deasserting m_axi_rready.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag gating reads and invalidating read data.

anchors.name: write
anchors.why: FIFO memory write enable.

anchors.name: read
anchors.why: FIFO memory read enable loading mem_read_data_reg.

anchors.name: m_axi_r
anchors.why: Packed R-channel word written into FIFO memory.

blocks.name: Read output stage
blocks.description: Two-register read path presenting FIFO entries to slave R channel.

anchors.name: mem_read_data_reg
anchors.why: Registered memory read data before output register.

anchors.name: mem_read_data_valid_reg
anchors.why: Valid flag for memory read stage data.

anchors.name: store_output
anchors.why: Loads output register and permits next FIFO read.

anchors.name: s_axi_r_reg
anchors.why: Output register holding packed R word for slave port.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Slave read data unpacked from output register.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Slave read valid from output register stage.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: Slave read ready allowing output register reload.

blocks.name: Master R input
blocks.description: Accepts master R beats when FIFO has space.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Master read data packed into FIFO entries.

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Master read valid triggering FIFO write when not full.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Master read ready, asserted while FIFO not full.

blocks.name: AR passthrough
blocks.description: AR channel wired directly from slave to master.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Read address passed through to master AR channel.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave AR valid bypassed to m_axi_arvalid.

anchors.name: m_axi_arready
anchors.why: Master AR ready bypassed to s_axi_arready.

axi_fifo.summary: AXI4 FIFO wrapper that instantiates a write-side FIFO (buffering W beats in RAM, passing AW/B) and a read-side FIFO (buffering R beats, passing AR).

blocks.name: write_fifo
blocks.description: Write-channel FIFO instance buffering W beats, passing AW and B.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data beats buffered by the write-channel FIFO.

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address passed through write FIFO to master side.

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: W valid pushing beats into the write FIFO RAM.

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: W ready reflecting write FIFO space.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data drained from the write FIFO to downstream.

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Master W valid when write FIFO holds data.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AW valid passed through the write FIFO block.

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: AW ready from write FIFO block.

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid passed back to slave side.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address forwarded downstream.

blocks.name: read_fifo
blocks.description: Read-channel FIFO instance buffering R beats, passing AR.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data drained from the read-channel FIFO to the slave side.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Read address passed through read FIFO to master side.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: R valid from read FIFO output stage.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: Slave R ready popping the read FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Downstream read data pushed into the read FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Master R ready reflecting read FIFO space.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AR valid passed through read FIFO block.

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: AR ready from read FIFO block.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Read address forwarded downstream.
